_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tu sê Zogadôr {player_id} tal Tris di tre zogadôrs.
Il to simbul al è '{symbol}'.
Tu fâs voltis metint il to simbul su un tavoliere 5x5 par formâ une line di cuatri.
Las linis a puedin jessi orizontâls, verticâls o diagonâls.
Invie il to moviment usant il formât '[4]' par segnâ la celule 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format di spostament no valid. doprâ "[cell]" là che la cjadene e je 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Numar di celule no valid: {cell}. Al à di jessi tra 0 e {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: La celule {cell} e je za ocupade.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Il zuiadôr {player_id} al à fate une mosse invalide.

game_action.placed: Zogadôr {player_id} met il so simbul ({symbol}) tal cjamp ({row}, {col}).
